Feet are rotated exactly 180 degrees relative to his LEFT-facing knees. The leftmost ends of BOTH feet must be smooth rounded heels with ZERO toenails or toe divisions. LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE narrow warm sunset shaft through dark dense canopy lights face, hands and both bare feet; walnut shadows and copper rim, disturbed ordinary leaf litter. Natural light, no magical mist.
SURFACE: Craggy wrinkled elderly skin, coarse beard, battered hat and heavy woven opaque cloth, wet roots.
SETTING: Dark Belize tropical jungle path. [tata-duende-c02,c05]
MOOD: Stern, uncanny authoritative forest guardian, awe-inspiring, never cute or comic. Respectful protective interpretation.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: TWO visible open palms each with exactly FOUR upright fingers and entirely smooth thumb-free side; BOTH bare feet heels LEFT and toes RIGHT, while knees and body face LEFT. No ordinary five-digit hand, no ordinary forward-facing foot. No text, lettering, logo, border, frame, watermark; no extra heads limbs digits; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design, no nudity, explicit gore, glow aura, neon or energy ribbon.
